sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2024 BMW M3 CS, finished in Brooklyn Grey with a black and red interior. The odometer on this M3 currently displays approximately 6,300 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this M3’s past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the M Carbon Exterior and M Driver's packages, 19-inch front and 20-inch rear Style 827M wheels, M carbon ceramic brakes, full Merino leather upholstery, power-adjustable and heated M carbon bucket front seats, and a Harman Kardon surround sound system. Notable modifications reported by the seller are limited to matte paint protection film. The M3 is held as the performance pinnacle of the BMW 3 Series, thanks to engineering refinements by BMW's in-house motorsport division. Now in its sixth generation, dubbed the G80, the BMW M3 offers a track-optimized chassis, twin-turbo power, technological enhancements for driving capabilities and comfort, and a more aggressive exterior design. For nearly 40 years, the BMW M3 line has remained a worthy competitor to its European performance brethren. The G80 M3 CS is a limited-edition, high-performance version of the M3 Competition. It uses extensive carbon-fiber components and unique chassis tuning to shed weight and sharpen handling over the standard M3, making it more track-focused while still retaining everyday usability. It was produced only for the 2024 model year. Power comes from a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged straight 6 engine, rated at about 543 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission.
